name: Inflation and Stock Market Performance in the United States
alternateName: Inflation and S&P 500 Monthly Returns Dataset
description: This dataset supports a project analyzing the relationship between U.S. inflation and stock market performance. It integrates monthly Consumer Price Index data from FRED with monthly S&P 500 market data acquired through the yfinance Python library. The final integrated dataset includes CPI values, monthly inflation rates, S&P 500 monthly open, high, low, close, volume, and monthly return values from 2000 through 2024.

variableMeasured.name: CPI
variableMeasured.description: Consumer Price Index value from FRED series CPIAUCNS.

variableMeasured.name: Open
variableMeasured.description: First S&P 500 opening value during the month.

variableMeasured.name: High
variableMeasured.description: Highest S&P 500 value during the month.

variableMeasured.name: Low
variableMeasured.description: Lowest S&P 500 value during the month.

variableMeasured.name: Close
variableMeasured.description: Last S&P 500 closing value during the month.

variableMeasured.name: Volume
variableMeasured.description: Total S&P 500 trading volume during the month.

variableMeasured.name: sp500_return_pct
variableMeasured.description: Monthly percent change in S&P 500 closing price.
